A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 15-page versions of the TexTok study. Their text, equations, six tables, ten figures, and Appendices A–F support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, class-conditional generation, text-to-image generation, timing, and ablation results, plus discrete-token and training-convergence experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main experimental tables and the appendix experiments and generated-image examples.

M1.justification: The tokenizer architecture, text conditioning, losses, and DiT generation procedures remain unchanged. Section 3.2 corrects inference wording from 'tokenization and generation' to 'generation and detokenization'; v1 already describes feeding captions into the detokenizer.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ImageNet reconstruction and class-conditional generation at 256×256 and 512×512, and text-to-image generation at 256×256. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout Tables 1–6. This includes the no-text baseline, SD-VAE-f8, and the class-conditional systems in Table 2, such as TiTok, MAR, and DiT-XL/2.

E3.justification: Evaluation splits, metrics, sample counts, model configurations, guidance, and sampling settings are retained. The default 270-epoch tokenizer and 350-epoch DiT training budgets in Appendix C are unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the same ablations of conditioning content, encoder size, conditioning architecture/location, and tokenizer size. The discrete-token experiments, training-convergence analysis, and supplementary generation examples also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate tables and training curves. Neither adds repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All experimental table values, curves, and generated-image examples are unchanged, including Table 2 FIDs of 1.46/1.62 and Table 3's 2.82 FID and 29.23 CLIP score. Figure 8's correction concerns an illustrative conditioning caption, rather than an evaluation outcome.

T1.justification: The latent-space definitions and encoder/decoder mathematical formulations in Sections 3.1–3.2 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: Section 5 now explicitly extends the state-of-the-art claim to text-to-image generation; v1's specific state-of-the-art comparisons concern class-conditional generation. The central contribution and headline numerical claims otherwise remain unchanged.

C2.justification: v1 emphasizes captions supplying semantics so tokens can encode remaining visual details. The revised abstract, introduction, and Appendix F emphasize simplified semantic learning and allocation of learning capacity and token space, refining the proposed mechanism without adding supporting analyses or limitations.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link in the abstract and corrects a caption example in Appendix D. Hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, and the caption-generation prompt remain unchanged; no experimental preprocessing change is established.

R1.justification: The 53 cited works and the specific prior-work comparisons in Section 2 and Appendix F are retained. A limited positioning change occurs in the conclusion, which extends state-of-the-art status to text-to-image generation without adding comparisons against prior text-to-image systems.

P1.justification: Several passages in the abstract, introduction, method, conclusion, and Appendix F are revised. v2 also corrects inference terminology and adds a funding acknowledgement. Section order and overall organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 8 replaces the guitar image's duplicated Persian-cat caption with a guitar description. Local text and reference reflow also occurs, while the figure/table inventory, image content, and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves clarity through the inference wording correction, fixes Figure 8's mismatched caption, and adds a project-page pointer. However, its conclusion extends the state-of-the-art claim to text-to-image generation while Table 3 still compares only against the no-text baseline. These limited improvements accompany a broader claim without corresponding evidence, leaving the net quality effect unclear.
